Pre-Screening Check

60-Second Donor Eligibility Checker

Answer these 5 rapid medical screening questions to check if you can safely donate whole blood or platelets today.

1. Are you between 18 and 65 years old?
Standard age criteria for voluntary whole blood donation.
2. Do you weigh at least 50 kg (110 lbs)?
Minimum body weight ensures safe blood volume collection.
3. Has it been at least 56 days (8 weeks) since your last whole blood donation?
Allows full replenishment of healthy red blood cells.
4. Are you feeling healthy and free from fever, cold, or active antibiotics today?
Active infections require a short recovery wait before donating.
5. Have you had a new tattoo, piercing, or major surgery in the past 6 months?
Standard safety deferral window for recent procedures.
